name: @tedix/os
description: Tedix OS, the product web application: conversations, workers, apps, skills, work management, and administration.

scripts.dev: bun run clear-port && bun run dev:fixtures
scripts.dev:local-demo: bun run clear-port && bun run dev:fixtures
scripts.build:local: TEDIX_LOCAL_COMPATIBILITY_DATE=2026-08-11 TEDIX_OS_LOCAL_DEV=1 bun ../../scripts/dev-local.ts -- vp build --mode development
scripts.deploy:production: vp build --mode production && cf deploy --mode production --prebuilt --message ${GIT_SHA:-${GITHUB_SHA:-unknown}}
scripts.test:run: bun run test:unit && bun run test:workerd && bun run test:browser:avatars && bun run test:browser:dialogs && bun run test:browser:deck && bun run test:browser:feed-deck && bun run test:browser:viewport && bun run test:browser:members && bun run test:browser:shell && bun run test:browser:social-cards && bun run test:browser:chat-list && bun run test:browser:chat-actions && bun run test:browser:state-gallery && bun run test:browser:memory && bun run test:browser:templates && bun run test:browser:outputs && bun run test:browser:tedis && bun run test:browser:work-iphone && bun run test:browser:settings && bun run test:browser:palette
scripts.test:browser:dialogs: bun browser-tests/run-specs.ts browser-tests/dialogs.spec.ts browser-tests/sheet-close.spec.ts browser-tests/b9-toast-phone.spec.ts browser-tests/approvals-popover.spec.ts browser-tests/kumo-popover.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser:outputs: bun browser-tests/run-specs.ts browser-tests/outputs.spec.ts browser-tests/output-workshop.spec.ts browser-tests/b8-outputs-iphone.spec.ts browser-tests/b9-export-phone.spec.ts browser-tests/b9-editor-toolbar.spec.ts browser-tests/slide-deletion-focus.spec.ts browser-tests/workspace-outputs-panel.spec.ts browser-tests/slides-gadget.spec.ts browser-tests/sheet-gadget.spec.ts browser-tests/document-editor.spec.ts

scripts.test:browser:settings: bun browser-tests/b9-settings-anchor.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/admin-destinations.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/account-list.spec.ts && bun browser-tests/connections-area.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser:viewport: bun browser-tests/run-specs.ts browser-tests/deck-viewport.spec.ts browser-tests/deck-responsive.spec.ts browser-tests/viewport-band.spec.ts browser-tests/deck-iphone.spec.ts browser-tests/canvas-pending.spec.ts browser-tests/app-settings-mcp.spec.ts browser-tests/cli-login.spec.ts
